campaign_response_name.name: campaign_response_name

connect_invitation_status.name: connect_invitation_status

form_version_publication.name: form_version_publication

jobs_key.value: length("jobs"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 200 and length("jobs"."kind") between 1 and 100
